lineage: Emerged Feb 2024 as a RaaS absorbing ex-ALPHV/LockBit affiliates; infrastructure went dark ~1 April 2025 with affiliates reportedly moving to Qilin and DragonForce
summary: RansomHub was the most prolific RaaS of 2024, with affiliates using phishing, password spraying and a broad set of edge-device CVEs for access, then Mimikatz, LOTL discovery, RMM tools and the custom EDRKillShifter BYOVD loader before deploying a Curve25519 intermittent encryptor that self-propagates over SMB. Its infrastructure went offline around 1 April 2025; the affiliate tradecraft (SocGholish Python backdoor, RDP password spray, Atera/Splashtop, Rclone SFTP) persists under successor brands.
uniqueTraits: EDRKillShifter custom BYOVD loader (password-protected) to kill EDR
Wide CVE list: Citrix CVE-2023-3519, FortiOS CVE-2023-27997, ActiveMQ CVE-2023-46604, Confluence CVE-2023-22515, BIG-IP CVE-2023-46747, FortiClient EMS CVE-2023-48788, EternalBlue, Zerologon
SocGholish (FakeUpdate) hand-off to an obfuscated Python SOCKS5 backdoor
Encryptor run with -pass and -only-local, self-copies over SMB as randomly named services, stops Hyper-V VMs; intermittent 1MB/2MB encryption
